# Aurex

> North Mississippi marketing agency for local service businesses: med spas, home services, and health practices. Based in North Mississippi, serving Oxford, Tupelo, Southaven, Olive Branch, and the Memphis area, plus clients nationwide.

Aurex is a North Mississippi marketing agency that helps local service businesses grow predictable revenue through lead capture, fast follow-up, customer reactivation, and retention systems. We prove ROI in 30 days before clients scale ad spend. We work on retainer ($500-$2,500/mo) and offer a loyalty program ($300/mo + $300 setup).

## Service area

Oxford, Tupelo, Southaven, Olive Branch, Hernando, Horn Lake, Batesville, New Albany, Pontotoc, Corinth, Holly Springs, Starkville, Columbus, and the greater Memphis area. Remote-friendly nationwide.
